metadata.description: Name of the azd environment — used to name the resource group and derive resource names.
Primary location for all resources.
GitHub/Copilot service token for the agent (ADR-002, superseded by ADR-005). Kept for the demo; unused while Foundry BYOK is active.
RouteStack sandbox public API key (INC-5). Empty = deterministic offline catalogue fallback.
RouteStack HMAC signing secret for the partner-token exchange (INC-5).
Use BYOK → Microsoft Foundry for the agent model (ADR-005). When false, falls back to the GitHub-token path.
Foundry model deployment name (also passed to the SDK as `model`).
Foundry model version to deploy.
Foundry embedding model deployment name (INC-8, ADR-008) — vectorises the travel-guide guide.
Foundry embedding model version.
Object ID of the deployer running the guide ingestion (grants AI Search ingestion roles). Empty skips the grant.
Principal ID of the user-assigned managed identity that needs AcrPull.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace to send container logs to.
Primary location for the Foundry resource.
Resource tags.
Name of the Foundry (AI Services) account.
Name of the Foundry project (v2).
Model deployment name (also passed to the SDK as `model`).
Model family/format.
Model version to deploy.
Deployment capacity (thousands of tokens/min). Must fit regional quota.
Embedding model deployment name (INC-8, ADR-008) — embeds the travel-guide guide.
Embedding model version.
Embedding deployment capacity (thousands of tokens/min).
Principal ID of the managed identity to grant model-inference access (Entra auth).
Optional principal ID of the deployer running guide ingestion (embeds via the embedding deployment). Empty skips the grant.
Principal ID of the user-assigned managed identity that queries the index (MCP read path).
Optional principal ID of the deployer/ingestion identity (creates + seeds the index). Empty skips the grant.
Endpoint of the AI Search service, e.g. https://<name>.search.windows.net
Principal ID of the Foundry project system-assigned identity.
Principal ID of the user-assigned managed identity granted data-plane access.
IP firewall allowlist. 0.0.0.0 permits Azure datacenters (Container Apps); the others are the Azure portal Data Explorer ranges.
azd service name (matches azure.yaml): "api" or "web".
Container image. Placeholder until azd deploy pushes the built image.
Secrets as [{ name, value }]. Referenced from envVars via secretRef.

envVars.value: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING', 'value', reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('rg-{0}', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'monitoring'), '2025-04-01').outputs.applicationInsightsConnectionString.value), createObject('name', 'WAYPOINT_DATA_MCP_URL', 'value', format('{0}/mcp', reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('rg-{0}', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'waypoint-data'), '2025-04-01').outputs.uri.value))), if(parameters('useFoundry'), createArray(createObject('name', 'FOUNDRY_MODEL_URL', 'value', reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('rg-{0}', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'foundry'), '2025-04-01').outputs.openAiEndpoint.value), createObject('name', 'FOUNDRY_MODEL', 'value', parameters('foundryModelName')), createObject('name', 'FOUNDRY_USE_MANAGED_IDENTITY', 'value', 'true'), createObject('name', 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID', 'value', reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('rg-{0}', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'identity'), '2025-04-01').outputs.clientId.value)), if(empty(parameters('copilotGitHubToken')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN', 'secretRef', 'copilot-github-token')))), variables('routestackEnv'))]
